units.source_text: 这之前，大竹夫人大概是担心，在房间里待不下去，

en.t: Before this, Mrs. Otake was probably anxious and could not stay in the room.

units.source_text: 便抱着桃太郎般的漂亮婴儿，一边在院子里散步，一边从远处一直望着对局室。

en.t: So she held the beautiful baby, like Momotaro, and walked around the garden while gazing steadily at the game room from a distance.
